**Finding: missing (medium severity) — TRANSITION**

The Agreement has no post-termination exit clause. Section 10 addresses only loss of access, Deliverable delivery and refunds; it mentions "any agreed transition period" without obliging Vendor to provide any. Critically, Section 16.5 carves Customer Data out of the confidentiality return/destroy duty and defers to "Sections 11 and 15" — **Section 11 does not exist** in the document, and Section 15 governs processing/privacy only. So there is no data return, export or deletion obligation anywhere, which fails even the fallback position.

**Redline (validated, ok:true)** — new Section 10.3 inserted after p0042 at the preferred position: up to six months' transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, return/export of Customer Data in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter (subject to routine backups and legal retention, to stay consistent with Section 16.5). The comment offers 90 days of assistance as a fallback.
